messages:
Jordan CSM: Heads up — Emerald wants final SLO alignment doc before renewal. They flagged latency spikes last week and asked about credits. Can we assemble a short playbook + numbers? @Maria Support @Tim SRE

Maria Support: From onboarding notes: traffic ramped ~3x after go-live, they're on batch inference. Median latency ~90ms, p95 ~480ms during peak. Monthly uptime ended at 99.72% vs 99.9% SLA.

Tim SRE: We had INC-2026 on 2026-05-10 — fallback routing didn't trigger due to a policy mismatch. Patch deployed same day. I can pull the uptime window and construct the SLA calc.

Jordan CSM: Need clear eligibility calc for credits and exact credit amount per contract. Does legal/sales clause say credit schedule? @Maria Support

Maria Support: Clause snippet from contract: "If monthly uptime < 99.9%, customer eligible for service credits. Credits scale by 0.1% decrement of uptime relative to 99.9% per monthly fee unit." Paste quick calc:

```
# simple credit calc (python-ish)
uptime = 0.9972  # 99.72%
monthly_fee = 20000.0
credit_units = max(0, (0.999 - uptime) / 0.001)
credit_amount = credit_units * monthly_fee * 0.01  # example scaling
print(credit_amount)
```

Tim SRE: I'll produce a CSV with daily uptime + latency percentiles for the month. ETA EOD. Recommend we offer a config tweak (cache prefix + smaller batch) and one pro onboarding session to reduce p95.

Jordan CSM: For renewal risk: Sales says if we come with proactive fix + documented credit calc, risk is low. @Lisa Onboard can you own the enablement runbook and customer session?

Lisa Onboard: On it. I'll book a 30-min ops deep-dive, include checklist: root cause recap, cache tuning steps, safe rollback plan, post-change monitoring. Also create a short feedback form to capture if they're satisfied.

Tim SRE: I'll attach the root-cause timeline and the incident postmortem notes to the doc. Legal: avoid offering a free month unless approved.

Jordan CSM: @deploy-bot can you post recent deploys around incident window?

deploy-bot: Deploys around 2026-05-10: release/edge-optimizer v2.14 -> 2026-05-10 03:21 UTC by @ci, no rollbacks.

Maria Support: Drafting the customer-facing SLO one-pager with numbers + proposed credit. Sharing link (draft): https://redwood.share/doc/emerald-slo-draft

Jordan CSM: :thumbsup: Please cc Alex AE for the renewal negotiation. Plan: doc + attach CSV evidence + offer one 30-min enabling session + apply credits per above. Thanks team.
